svg.aria-label: Binary search: every step throws away half of what is left
svg.text: Binary search: every step throws away half of what is left
A sorted list of 16 numbers. We look for 47. Blue = still possible, yellow = the middle we check.
The question behind O(log n): how many times can I halve n until 1 is left?
1,000,000 items need only about 20 steps (2²⁰ ≈ 1,000,000). Double the list: just 1 more step.
